paras: Anolis delafuentei, also known commonly as the Escambray crested anole and the Guamuhaya anole, is a species of lizard in the family Dactyloidae. The species is endemic to Cuba.
The specific name, delafuentei, is in honor of Argentinian herpetological paleontologist Marcelo S. de la Fuente.
The preferred natural habitat of A. delafuentei is forest, at an altitude of 700 m (2,300 ft).
A. delafuentei is known only from the holotype, which is a male with a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 6 cm (2.4 in).
A. delafuentei is a member of the A. sagrei species group.
